lines.say: 2,461 tests, a 100% pass rate, and not a single screenshot or mouse click.
CLI-Anything turns professional software into command-line tools that AI agents can actually use.
AI agents are great at reasoning, but terrible at using real professional software.
Today's fixes are fragile UI automation, limited APIs, or reimplementations that miss 90% of functionality.
You point one Claude Code plugin at a codebase, and a 7-phase pipeline builds the CLI.
It goes from codebase analysis to architecture, implementation, tests and documentation, all the way to PyPI publishing.
Every generated CLI calls the real application, like Blender, LibreOffice or FFmpeg, and returns JSON for the agent.
It has been battle-tested across 18 major applications, from GIMP to Blender to Draw.io.
In one demo, an agent draws a full HTTPS handshake diagram from scratch in about 4 minutes.
To start, run pip install cli-anything-hub, then browse ready-made CLIs with cli-hub list.
Send this to someone whose agent still clicks through screenshots.
